correctness.rationale: Directly from multiplication, y=x² and x(x³−bx−1)=0; determinant of the structure matrix is −1 in every characteristic. Rational roots of the monic cubic can only be ±1, excluded exactly when b∉{0,2}; its discriminant is 4b³−27. The cyclic group C3 has identity fixed-point count 3 once out of three; S3 conjugacy proportions for 3/1/0 fixed points are 1/6,1/2,1/3. Chebotarev applies outside the finite discriminant-prime set. Independently enumerated all idempotents over 13 small primes at four b values and verified b=1,3 discriminants; this does not prove densities.
